_doc: Known defects of released versions that this module reproduces. report.py tags a finding with the id when one entry of match fits it: same rule, and (if given) a case whose id starts with casePrefix and a cause (mechanism and place) that contains causeContains. The cause is part of the match on purpose: a new failure under the same rule (another error, another file) is not tagged, so it shows up as a new signature instead of hiding in the known family. The tag only names the finding; whether it is a finding is decided by the cases and rules alone.

U1.title: The #error of DevTools/KenseiDebugReleaseCheck.cs fires in content builds (SBP, Addressables, AssetBundles) while Debug Mode is on; with Addressables 2.9.1+ building content with the player, a Development player build fails too
